readinessLevels.label: Source catalog only
readinessLevels.userMeaning: Official sources are tracked, but this path should not be guided or completed until source and field mapping are verified.

readinessLevels.label: Verified worksheet path
readinessLevels.userMeaning: Smarter Justice can collect organized facts, documents, and review notes for a Human Review Specialist or professional reviewer.

readinessLevels.label: Field-mapped draft foundation
readinessLevels.userMeaning: Required facts are organized in a way that can later be mapped to official form fields after verification and review.

readinessLevels.label: Completed draft may be prepared after review
readinessLevels.userMeaning: A completed draft may be prepared only after official-source verification, missing-answer checks, and Human Review Specialist approval.

readinessLevels.label: Sign-ready after review candidate
readinessLevels.userMeaning: Only future verified paths can become sign-ready after human/professional review and user verification.

draftReadinessLevels.label: Not selected yet
draftReadinessLevels.userMeaning: Smarter Justice has not matched this saved work to a supported draft path yet.

draftReadinessLevels.label: Organizer only
draftReadinessLevels.userMeaning: Answers are organized for review, but no official-form field map is active yet.

draftReadinessLevels.label: Form information organized
draftReadinessLevels.userMeaning: The user’s answers are mapped to the fields used by the selected form so they can be checked.

draftReadinessLevels.label: Draft organized for review
draftReadinessLevels.userMeaning: Saved answers, missing items, official instructions, and supporting documents can be checked before a draft is shown.

draftReadinessLevels.label: Available for user review
draftReadinessLevels.userMeaning: After the required review, the user can review, correct, sign, and file the draft when appropriate.
